title: Wireless Earbuds Bluetooth 5.3 with Charging Case, 30 h Playtime
description:
Compact true wireless earbuds for commuting, workouts and calls, with a pocket-size case that tops them up on the go.
• Bluetooth 5.3 with stable connection and a low-latency game mode
• Up to 6 h per charge and 30 h in total with the case; USB-C charging
• Touch controls and dual microphones with noise reduction for calls
• IPX5 sweat- and splash-resistant; 3 sizes of silicone ear tips included

title: Active Noise Cancelling Headphones, Wireless Over-Ear, 50 h Battery
description:
Over-ear headphones that block out engine hum and office chatter, so you can focus on music, podcasts or calls.
• Active noise cancellation with transparency mode
• Up to 50 h playback with ANC off; 5-minute quick charge gives 3 h; USB-C
• 40 mm drivers, soft protein-leather cushions and a foldable design
• Bluetooth 5.3 plus 3.5 mm cable for wired listening; carry case included

title: Gaming Headset with Noise-Reducing Microphone and RGB Lights
description:
Wired gaming headset for most consoles and PCs, with clear voice chat and immersive sound for long sessions.
• 50 mm drivers with deep bass
• Flexible noise-reducing boom microphone with mute button
• Memory-foam ear cushions and adjustable padded headband
• 3.5 mm jack for most consoles, PCs, laptops and smartphones; USB plug powers the RGB lights

title: Portable Bluetooth Speaker 20 W, IPX7 Waterproof, with Carry Strap
description:
Rugged speaker for the beach, pool, hikes and garden parties, loud enough to fill a patio.
• 20 W stereo sound with passive bass radiator
• IPX7 waterproof and dustproof
• Up to 15 h playtime; USB-C charging
• Pair two speakers for true stereo; built-in microphone for hands-free calls

title: Mini Bluetooth Speaker 5 W with Lanyard, Pocket Size
description:
Palm-size speaker that clips to a backpack or sits on a desk for podcasts and background music.
• 5 W full-range driver
• Up to 8 h playtime; USB-C charging
• Bluetooth 5.3 with a range of up to 10 m
• Fabric grille, removable lanyard and hands-free microphone

title: Wireless Speaker 20 W with Stereo Pairing and Deep Bass
description:
Stylish speaker for kitchens, bedrooms and home offices that sounds bigger than its size.
• 2 × 10 W drivers with bass radiator
• Up to 12 h playtime; USB-C charging
• Pair two units for stereo; AUX input for wired devices
• Splash-resistant (IPX5) fabric-covered housing

title: Smartwatch with 1.85 Inch Display, Bluetooth Calls and Activity Tracking
description:
Everyday smartwatch that shows calls and messages from most smartphones and keeps track of your steps, workouts and sleep.
• 1.85 inch colour touchscreen with customisable watch faces
• Answer calls with the built-in microphone and speaker; message and app notifications
• 100+ sport modes, step counter, heart rate and sleep tracking (for general fitness and wellness use only)
• Up to 7 days battery; IP67 water-resistant; magnetic charger included

title: Fitness Tracker Band with Colour Display, Step and Sleep Tracking
description:
Slim, lightweight activity band that keeps an eye on daily steps, workouts and sleep habits.
• 1.1 inch AMOLED colour display
• Step counter, calories, 20 sport modes, heart rate and sleep tracking (for general fitness and wellness use only)
• Call and message notifications from most smartphones
• Up to 14 days battery; water-resistant to 5 ATM

title: 4K Action Camera with Waterproof Case and Mounting Kit
description:
Small, tough camera for capturing cycling, skiing, snorkelling and holiday adventures in sharp detail.
• 4K/30fps video and 20 MP photos; 170° wide-angle lens
• 2 inch screen and electronic image stabilisation
• Waterproof to 30 m in the included case
• Kit includes 2 × 1050 mAh batteries, helmet and handlebar mounts, clips and adhesive pads

title: LED Ring Light 26 cm with Tripod Stand and Phone Holder
description:
Even, flattering light for video calls, live streams, make-up and product photos.
• 26 cm ring with 3 colour modes (warm, neutral, cool) and 10 brightness levels
• Tripod stand extends from 50 to 160 cm
• Adjustable holder for most smartphones; Bluetooth remote shutter
• USB powered with inline controller

title: Tilting TV Wall Mount for 32–70 Inch TVs, up to 45 kg
description:
Low-profile bracket that hangs your TV close to the wall, with a gentle tilt to cut glare from windows and lamps.
• Fits most 32–70 inch TVs with wall-mount hole patterns from 100 × 100 to 400 × 400 mm
• Holds up to 45 kg; tilts from −8° to +8°
• Only 3.5 cm from the wall, with levelling after installation
• Fixings for solid walls and a small bubble level included

title: 4K HDMI Cable 2 m, Braided, 18 Gbps with Gold-Plated Connectors
description:
High-speed cable for connecting TVs, monitors, projectors, consoles and laptops.
• Supports 4K at 60 Hz, HDR and audio return channel
• Bandwidth up to 18 Gbps
• Nylon-braided jacket and gold-plated connectors with aluminium shells
• Length 2 m

title: Foldable Camera Drone with 4K Camera, GPS and 30-Minute Flight, Under 249 g
description:
Pocket-size folding drone for aerial photos and video on holidays and hikes. Ages 14+.
• 4K camera on a 2-axis gimbal with live view on your phone via the app
• GPS return-to-home, altitude hold and follow-me mode
• Up to 30 minutes per battery; take-off weight under 249 g
• Includes remote controller, 1 battery, spare propellers and carry case; check local drone rules before flying

title: Mini Drone with Propeller Guards, 1080p Camera and One-Key Take-Off
description:
Beginner-friendly drone with fully enclosed propellers, ideal for learning to fly indoors and in the garden. Ages 14+.
• 1080p camera with live view on your phone
• One-key take-off and landing, altitude hold and headless mode
• 2 batteries for about 2 × 12 minutes of flight
• Weighs under 250 g; check local drone rules before flying outdoors

title: Power Bank 20000 mAh with 22.5 W Fast Charging and USB-C PD
description:
High-capacity portable charger that can refill a typical smartphone four to five times.
• 20000 mAh lithium-polymer battery (74 Wh), allowed in hand luggage on most flights
• USB-C PD input/output up to 20 W plus USB-A output up to 22.5 W
• Charges 3 devices at once
• LED battery level indicator

title: Power Bank 10000 mAh with Built-In Cables and Digital Display
description:
Slim power bank with its own cables attached, so you never have to remember a charging lead.
• 10000 mAh battery with digital percentage display
• Built-in USB-C and Micro-USB cables plus a USB-A output
• 15 W fast charging; recharges via USB-C
• Weighs about 220 g and fits in a jacket pocket

title: USB-C to USB-C Cable 2 m, 100 W Fast Charging, Braided, 2 Pack
description:
Tough braided cables for fast charging phones, tablets and laptops, and for syncing data.
• Up to 100 W (20 V / 5 A) power delivery with built-in e-marker chip
• USB 2.0 data transfer up to 480 Mbps
• Nylon-braided jacket, reinforced cable joints and aluminium connector housings
• 2 cables, each 2 m long

title: USB 3.0 Hub with 7 Ports and Individual On/Off Switches
description:
Adds extra ports to a laptop or desktop for drives, keyboards, mice and card readers.
• 7 × USB-A 3.0 ports, up to 5 Gbps
• Individual switch with LED indicator for each port
• 1 m cable; plug and play, no drivers needed
• DC input for an optional power adapter when running several drives

title: Mini Projector with Wireless Screen Mirroring, 1080p Supported
description:
Compact home cinema projector for movie nights, gaming and cartoons on a wall or screen up to 150 inches.
• Native 720p resolution, accepts 1080p input; brightness approx. 200 ANSI lumens
• Wireless screen mirroring from most smartphones, plus HDMI, USB and AV inputs
• Built-in speaker and 3.5 mm audio output
• Keystone correction and zoom; remote control and EU plug included

title: Portable Projector Screen 100 Inch with Stand, 16:9
description:
Foldable screen for indoor movie nights and backyard cinema that sets up in minutes without tools.
• 100 inch diagonal (221 × 125 cm viewing area), 16:9 format
• Matte white surface with 160° viewing angle; washable
• Height-adjustable tripod stand, plus ropes and pegs for outdoor use
• Carry bag included

title: Bluetooth Key Finder Tag with Loud Ring, for Keys, Bags and Luggage
description:
A small tracker tag for the things you misplace most: tap it in the app and it rings so you can follow the sound.
• 85 dB ring up to 60 m away; the app shows where the tag was last connected
• Press the tag's button to ring a phone that is set to silent
• Works with Android and iOS through the free companion app
• Replaceable CR2032 battery lasting up to 12 months; key ring included
